text:
jamie: Bringing the eu-south4 observability stack live today — logs (fluentd->loki), metrics (prometheus), traces (tempo). This cluster will host GPU inference capacity, so we need driver metrics + DCGM scraping. Need a short validation checklist and a clean handoff to eng-platform. Any immediate blockers? @alex @sara

alex: Quick Qs: 1) Is the cluster in a shared VPC or customer-dedicated? 2) Are we routing logs over the inter-region peering (bandwidth/cost)? For GPU hosts make sure we deploy: node-exporter, nvidia-smi-exporter (or dcgm-exporter), and weight DCGM scrape intervals (30s) to avoid hot reads. Also ensure node-level logs (kern.log / dmesg) are captured — GPU OOMs show up there.

jamie: Shared VPC for now. We'll pin the inference nodes to a labeled nodePool (gpu-inference-eus4). We'll need to confirm IAM roles for fluentd to write to loki and that loki tenant rate limits are set. Cost note: initial estimate says ~120GB/day of logs because of driver noise on startup — recommend setting retention to 14d and enabling sampling on debug logs.

sara: Validation checklist I ran through last time — paste below. Use as a baseline and add region specifics.
- Core services: prometheus, loki, tempo, grafana, alertmanager running
- Exporters: node-exporter, dcgm-exporter, kube-state-metrics, cadvisor
- Fluentd/forwarder healthy and writing to loki (check active HTTP 200s)
- Prom scrapes for GPU nodes show node_cpu, nvidia_gpu_temperature, nvidia_gpu_utilization
- Traces: simple end-to-end span from inference service -> model server captured in tempo
- Dashboards: GPU health, node resource heatmap, Loki ingestion by pod
- Alerts fired against test conditions: high-ingest, scrape-failure, loki-queue-saturation
- Smoke queries: logs query for recent OOMs, prom query for avg_gpu_utilization over 5m

sara: Example commands:```kubectl -n observability get pods -o wide``` ```kubectl -n observability logs deploy/fluentd -f --since=1h``` ```promtool check-config /etc/prometheus/prometheus.yml```

alex: Alert templates to reuse: observability_ingest_high (rate > 500MB/min sustained 5m), prometheus_scrape_down (targets_down > 0 for 2m), gpu_temp_critical (nvidia_gpu_temperature > 90 for 1m). Sample alert (PromAlertManager style):
```yaml
- alert: GPUTemperatureCritical
  expr: nvidia_gpu_temperature > 90
  for: 1m
  labels:
    severity: critical
  annotations:
    summary: "GPU temp > 90C on {{ $labels.instance }}"
```

jamie: On retention/cost — can we set index / chunking for Loki to smaller retention initially and ramp to longer only if needed? Also enable label-based routing: drop verbose driver logs except when node label debug=true.

alex: Yep, implement loki ingestion rules + tenant_rate_limits. Also add a cost bucket in the Terraform vars: observability_cost_center = "eu-south4-proof" so finance can track. I'll open a PR for the terraform vars after smoke pass.

deploy-bot: obs-stack: terraform plan complete — no changes to production resources.

ops-bot: obs-stack: apply initiated by alex. ETA ~3m.

ops-bot: obs-stack: apply succeeded in 2m42s — components: prometheus, loki, tempo, grafana, fluentd, node-exporters.

jamie: Nice. Next steps for handoff: 1) attach runbook + checklist to ticket, 2) run smoke scripts (sara), 3) snapshot dashboards and export JSON to our dashboard repo, 4) tag oncall with paging rules, 5) create post-provision cost summary and set retention defaults.

sara: I'll run the smoke scripts now and update the ticket with results. Posting runbook link: https://internal.redwood/ops/runbooks/obs-turnup (placeholder). Will export grafana dashboards to: gitlab.com/redwood/infra-dashboards/tree/eu-south4.

alex: PR: https://git.internal.redwood/infra/infra-terraform/-/merge_requests/342 (adds observability_cost_center & loki tenant config). Please review.

jamie: Great work team. If smoke checks pass we'll mark as ready for eng-platform handoff and schedule a short 30m sync to review alerts and paging. :thumbsup:

sara: Smoke checks: fluentd 200 responses, prom scraping GPU nodes, tempo traces present, sample dashboard panels show GPU metrics. Found one minor issue: loki query for "driver error" returns noisy results, I'll add a pipeline stage to drop unhelpful driver noise. Updating ticket now.

jamie: Awesome — thanks. Leaving this thread open until handoff complete.

ops-bot: ticket OBS-876 created and assigned to eng-platform for handoff.
